package local

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type closeRecorder struct {
	io.Reader
	closed bool
}

func (body *closeRecorder) Close() error {
	body.closed = true
	return nil
}

// An http.RoundTripper closes the request body on every path, the
// canceled early return included.
func TestTransportClosesTheBody(t *testing.T) {
	handler := http.HandlerFunc(func(writer http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		writer.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
	})
	for _, canceled := range []bool{false, true} {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		if canceled {
			cancel()
		}
		body := &closeRecorder{Reader: strings.NewReader("{}")}
		request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, "http://gofastr.local/notes", body)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		response, err := (transport{handler: handler}).RoundTrip(request)
		if err == nil {
			response.Body.Close()
		}
		cancel()
		if !body.closed {
			t.Errorf("canceled=%v: request body left open", canceled)
		}
	}
}
